name: Image3D AI
tagline: Image3D AI is a comprehensive online platform designed to transform 2D images into high-quality 3D models and STL files
description: Image3D AI is a comprehensive online platform designed to transform 2D images into high-quality 3D models and STL files. By leveraging advanced AI technologies like Hunyuan 3D, Tripo, and Meshy, the tool provides a fast and efficient way to generate digital assets from simple uploads. The system supports multiple input formats including PNG, JPEG, and WEBP, with a maximum file size of 10MB per upload.
